title: Input validation on all inbound messages (zod)
description: Ensure every inbound WS message and REST body is validated with the shared zod schemas before touching game state, with structured rejection and zero crashes on malformed input.
acceptanceCriteria: No server code path reads an unvalidated message field: WS dispatch validates via parseMessage before handler; REST routes validate bodies/params/queries with shared schemas
Invalid messages return structured error {code:'invalid-message', message} and do not mutate state; connection stays alive for valid messages afterwards

Fuzz test: 20 crafted malformed payloads (wrong types, NaN, Infinity, depth-30 nesting, 1 MB string, negative seq, unknown fields where forbidden) sent to a live server — all rejected with invalid-message, server still answers /api/health
zod safeParse results used (no throw-based control flow); validation errors logged at debug level without echoing raw payload to the client beyond the error code

steps.details: Grep server handlers for direct payload field access; list every message type and REST route; confirm each has a schema (add missing ones to shared/protocol/schemas.ts).

WS dispatcher: safeParse → on failure send invalid-message error, increment per-connection invalid counter (drop at 50). REST: fastify schema validation or manual safeParse in a preHandler; 400 responses with {code, message} only.

tests/validation-fuzz.spec.ts (node, not playwright): boot server in-process, open ws, send the 20 payloads, assert invalid-message each time, then assert health endpoint still 200 and a valid hello→auth flow still succeeds.
Run npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test; record results; commit.

technicalNotes: Use .strict() on payload schemas so unknown fields are rejected (prevents field-spraying probes).
Depth/size limits: cap JSON parse size at 64 KB per message at the ws layer (on 'message', check length before parse).
